Here g=r^4−6r^2+24r log r−4r+9; g(1)=0, g'(r)=4(r^3−3r+6log r+5)>0 for r≥1. For F=6r^5−19r^4+18r^3+12r^2−24rlog r−8r−9, F(1)=F'(1)=F''(1)=0, F'''(1)=36>0 and F''''(r)=720r−456−48/r^3>0 for r≥1. Hence strict signs hold for every λt>0, not only sampled time points. Large-r leading variance and covariance yield correlation limit −sqrt(6)/12. P restored by λ−1.
